problem: The rejected answer-obligation compiler v1 correctly extracts q679's request for a project named in the acknowledgments section, but the generic overlap scorer still selects an author-biography window. The literal answer occurs in the already-retrieved document under an ACKNOWLEDGMENT heading.
simplest_baseline: Keep answer_obligation_window_v1: compile the intended answer clause, then rank every fixed-size window only by obligation and whole-question term overlap.
hypothesis: When the compiled obligation explicitly names a document section, ranking windows that contain a normalized alias of that section before generic term overlap will preserve the three v1 hits and expose q679's answer, with no provider, search, or Judge call.
changed_mechanisms: deterministic section-anchor priority in fixed-size evidence-window ranking
anti_claim: This is an outcome-selected, gold-aware development calibration. It tests evidence visibility inside already-retrieved gold documents and does not improve the frozen model or establish end-to-end benchmark gains.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: The correct document and answer obligation are already known in this diagnosed cluster; another research role would add calls without correcting the deterministic section-selection error.
A larger graph cannot guarantee that an already-retrieved long document exposes the requested section; the smaller missing boundary is section-aware evidence selection.
More crawling is unnecessary for a document that is already present; this test isolates evidence extraction before publisher repair.
Parallel search addresses branch coverage, not selection of a named section inside a retrieved document.

frozen_controls: same retrieved gold documents and local document index
same v1 answer-obligation compiler and generic overlap scorer
next_action: Do not run an end-to-end paid arm yet. First test whether a deterministic no-gold selector can choose the answer-bearing document from only the documents already disclosed by the baseline trace. Require full four-case target coverage before wiring a bounded post-run evidence overlay.
claim_boundary: Even a 4/4 calibration pass authorizes only a later no-gold document-targeting oracle and bounded development repair. It is not a fresh-slice, official, leaderboard, or model-capability result.
